title: What every reference dataset shares
description: A field of a record is a value with the source it comes from (PL-10). A value people read carries one text per language Household ships (PRD 03 §9).

key.description: A record's identifier: lower-case ASCII words joined by underscores.

sourceId.description: The id of a source in sources.json.

text.description: Text that is not empty and neither starts nor ends with a space.

localized.description: One text per language Household ships. A test holds this list to the server's i18n.Locales, so a language added there fails until every record is translated into it.

decimal.description: An exact decimal as a string, written without a trailing zero after the point.

field.description: A value and where it comes from. `drafted` marks a value drafted without an expert (PL-10): a reviewer who has checked it against its source removes the flag. `note` tells the reviewer what the source alone does not.

localizedField.description: A field whose value people read, in each language.

keyField.description: A field whose value is another record's key.

textField.description: A field whose value is the same text in every language.

unitSystemField.description: A field whose value is a system of units (PRD 03 §9: metric by default, imperial available).
